summary: Backend-only test of Social Media Studio V1 (feature_social_studio). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_social_studio.py with 31 tests covering role guard, generation, post CRUD, regenerate (all tone actions + regen_hook/regen_caption scoping + invalid action), status transitions (approve/schedule/mark-posted/dismiss), analytics shape, settings GET/PUT (incl. empty-body 400), daily-task idempotency, daily-regenerate archival, pillar rotation, and regression against habits/today, notifications/settings, coach/messages/drafts, coach/change-log, coach/tasks (contains daily_social_media_post), and standby/today. All 31 tests PASSED. Atlas generation returns full valid shape (title/hook/script/teleprompter_script/caption/hashtags/cta/visual_notes/platform_recommendation/post_type/best_posting_time_local/angle). Fallback path works when LLM misbehaves.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_social_studio.py: /social/posts POST doc assembly is duplicated in _new_post_doc(); minor DRY smell but not blocking.

PATCH /social/posts/{id} validates only body.status against STATUSES; other invalid enum fields (platform, post_type) are accepted as-is. Consider Pydantic Literal or explicit validation if strict enums are required.
GET /social/posts list projection excludes revision_history for list view — good for payload size, but note detail endpoint returns full history (correct).
seed_data_creation: Tests use historical dates (2025-01-15..18) for daily-task cases to avoid polluting today's ticker state. Test posts are prefixed TEST_ and best-effort dismissed after each class.
